say:1:1131008001:1.text: I heard about what happened to the other tribes. So many lives have been lost searching for the treasure...
say:1:1131008001:1.source_cn: 我听说了其他部族的遭遇，很多人……在寻宝的过程中遇难。
say:1:1131008001:1.male: I heard about what happened to the other tribes. So many lives have been lost searching for the treasure...
say:1:1131008001:1.female: I heard about what happened to the other tribes. So many lives have been lost searching for the treasure...

say:2:1131008002:1.text: We are lucky to be alive, but how can we celebrate with so many of our kin no longer with us?
say:2:1131008002:1.source_cn: 有那么多同胞遇难，我们这些侥幸活下来的人，怎么能欢天喜...
say:2:1131008002:1.male: We are lucky to be alive, but how can we celebrate with so many of our kin no longer with us?
say:2:1131008002:1.female: We are lucky to be alive, but how can we celebrate with so many of our kin no longer with us?

say:3:1131008003:1.text: May the Dusk Lord's light shine upon their souls...
say:3:1131008003:1.source_cn: 希望残阳神的光辉照耀他们的灵魂……
say:3:1131008003:1.male: May the Dusk Lord's light shine upon their souls...
say:3:1131008003:1.female: May the Dusk Lord's light shine upon their souls...
